hypothesis: The residual-only transported-shape objective can have uphill directions under the frozen-metric GN approximation. Explicitly study a true-gradient direction with the existing SPD residual normal matrix as preconditioner; do not infer a physical likelihood from normalized surface shapes.
objective: For each pose, exact Euclidean nearest target point selects both target point and target world-frame shape. Strict max-distance gate. Unit weights only. F=0.5 sum r^T(Ct+R Cs R.T)^-1 r over matched source rows, with source shapes canonicalized as before. No log determinant: this is a declared residual score on normalized shapes, not calibrated Gaussian maximum likelihood. Target assignment is piecewise; it need not minimize the anisotropic score.
gradient: At a supported baseline use existing frozen H and b. Compute e=C^-1 r, S=R Cs R.T, g_metric_rotation=sum(e cross(S e)), g=[-b_translation,-b_rotation+g_metric_rotation]. Solve using the same RMS-radius normalization, undamped Cholesky and pivot guard, with RHS=-g. H is explicitly a positive-definite preconditioner, not the exact Hessian of F. No floor/damping/fallback.
trials: Same retraction and six scales[1,.5,.25,.125,.0625,.03125]. Requery all source points, reselect target points/shapes and retransport source shapes at every candidate. Accept first finite proper candidate only if literal ordered matched-source IDs equal baseline, cost<Fbaseline and cost<=Fbaseline+1e-4*scale*(g dot delta). Record full refreshed costs and source-support equality separately. Source-support changes cannot produce an accepted decrease. Do not force target IDs to match.
stopping: Keep iteration budget30 and translation1e-4/rotation1e-5 defaults. Same positive support/radius/rank/numeric checks first. ConvergedStep means both norms of the full solved preconditioned-gradient direction meet existing tolerances; no shortened-step or small-cost convergence. Otherwise require finite negative g dot delta before trials; finite non-descent ->no_descent, nonfinite->nonfinite. Trial arithmetic failures cannot adopt state. If all finite supported trials fail the rule, no_descent; no fabricated convergence. Return last accepted pose plus ordinary final rematch/cost. Optional existing cycle guard runs on eligible baseline states after full-direction convergence check.
api: If the independent prototype passes numerical controls and shows a useful real fixed-input result, add explicit Rust RegistrationObjective::{FrozenMetric,TransportedShapes}, RegistrationParams.objective default FrozenMetric and Python objective='frozen'|'transported' to standalone and prepared APIs. Reject transported with robust_scale specified rather than silently omitting a weight derivative. Default/frozen code, output keys, values and histories retain every bit. New mode adds objective='transported', per-history objective_gradient, metric_gradient_rotation and trial_support_equal. Existing normal_matrix/right_hand_side retain frozen definitions; step uses corrected RHS. No frontend adoption.
prototype: Before native implementation, independent NumPy/SciPy kernel/solver/nearest/retraction on all72 frozen real problems, two shape families. Default30 iterations and same tolerances/scales. Preserve full results and every trial including support changes; report all statuses, original-converged transitions and costs, no result-driven threshold tuning. Controls include analytic9/22 metric-gradient, finite differences, isotropic source shape, frame/basis/source-origin invariants, large origins, strict support gate, empty/low/singular/nonfinite/no-descent, trial rejection and unchanged full-direction convergence.
verification: Full native suite, default72 bit comparisons to PR300 and cycle-enabled72 bit comparisons to PR302; transported native vs independent decisions/poses/gradients/matches/costs/trials, serial/parallel/standalone/prepared/reused/shared/owned and history on/off. Fixed explicit assignment native gradient controls plus all686 old real baseline gradients and all new accepted full-cost transitions. Verify legacy660-scan motion and185-scan frontend byte outputs. Unit controls are not performance data.
adoption: Opt-in experimental objective only. Compare and report regressions as well as improvements on all72 inputs. This slice cannot establish online trajectory accuracy or GLIM-level physical performance. Keep initialization gates and rejected states unchanged; reference-trajectory evaluation needs a separately frozen study.
preservation: All old protocols/controllers/source/native snapshots, failed attempts and receipts remain verbatim. Use fresh output paths and complete private native package snapshots; never replace installed extension. Exclude disposable pytest/cache trees from evidence manifests. Public packet/controllers get LF rules and fresh autocrlf checkout verification.
